findings.summary: Brain launch kill-switch flags are declared but not enforced by the feature-flag boundary.
findings.details: S13-T03 requires risky external surfaces to remain default-off until launch enablement. The implementation declares disabled Brain launch defaults for semantic operations and external delivery, but those defaults are not included in the evaluated default feature flag list, and the durable FeatureFlagKey table schema still rejects those keys. As a result, the public flag list/evaluate surface will not return these Brain external-risk kill switches and workspace overrides for them cannot be persisted through the existing feature-flag boundary.
